[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Klito''' was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] who served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] as a [[Hangar Deck Officer]] aboard the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Subjugator (Victory-class)|''Subjugator'']]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the ''Subjugator'' fell under [[Attack on the Subjugator|attack]] from a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Task Force Starfall|task force]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kolaff]], the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]], ordered Klito to prepare the command [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] for departure, in order to allow the Imperial [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Lira Wessex/Legends|Lira Wessex]] to escape.
